description: This file defines the TypeORMDriver class for managing vector store operations with PostgreSQL, including connection setup, document sanitization, and similarity search functionalities.

classes.name: TypeORMDriver
classes.description: A driver class for interfacing with PostgreSQL vector stores using TypeORM, supporting document addition, deletion, similarity search, and connection management.

methods.name: getPostgresConnectionOptions
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs and returns PostgreSQL connection options, including handling additional configuration and validation.

methods.name: getArgs
methods.description: Returns arguments needed to initialize the vector store, including connection options, table name, and schema.

methods.name: instanciate
methods.description: Creates and adapts a vector store instance with optional metadata filters.

methods.name: fromDocuments
methods.description: Creates and adapts a vector store instance from an array of documents.

methods.name: sanitizeDocuments
methods.description: Removes null characters from document page content to prevent PostgreSQL errors.

methods.name: adaptInstance
methods.description: Replaces methods in the vector store instance to customize similarity search, deletion, and document addition, using PostgreSQL connection pooling.

methods.name: computedOperatorString
methods.description: Determines the distance operator string based on the distance strategy input.

methods.name: ensureTableInDatabase
methods.description: Ensures the target table and pgvector extension exist in the database, creating them if necessary.
